theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), SFinite (μHE[n].restrict M) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Measurable (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y ∂μHE[n])
